versions.changelog: Add qBraid Lab tools: environment management, GPU/CPU compute provisioning, and autonomous remote coding agents over SSH — with a separate per-minute spend gate (KANNAKA_LAB_ALLOW_SPEND). Quantum tools unchanged.
Initial release: resonance recall as amplitude amplification, quantum RNG, and OpenQASM 3 circuits on qBraid (free sim) or real QPUs, with spend guards.
